summary: A parked worker brought back by the owner's words (a pick or @name) now gets those words as its prompt, never rollcall's 'you were parked' notice in their place; only the first of two callers resumes it, and what the other carries waits on its queue.
why: The watcher's notice raced the owner's words and won, so a worker never saw the owner's pick and a guard waiting on his word skipped the [rollcall] line.
